card.name: Mid-clause words in narrative prose
card.fires_on: Short function or verb words in the middle of a clause in historical or narrative general-web prose, such as "at <<any>> rate", "never <<even>>" and "would <<get>>". The next word is often a hedge or an idiomatic continuation.

card.writes: It promotes hedges like "perhaps" and suppresses casual intensifiers like "basically", "totally" and "dude", pushing toward a formal, tentative register.
card.plain: It fires on small mid-sentence words in formal storytelling and nudges the text toward hedged, literary wording rather than slang.
